Makes a copy of the pixels of a buffer that [ReadPixelFast](ReadPixelFast) and [WritePixelFast](WritePixelFast) can use quickly. What the program writes reaches the buffer when [UnlockBuffer](UnlockBuffer) is called, so do not forget it. Do not use the other drawing commands while a buffer is locked.

```blitzbasic
;media still buffers/lockbuffer.png
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
LockBuffer BackBuffer()
For y = 0 To 239
	For x = 0 To 319
		WritePixelFast x, y, ((x * 255 / 319) Shl 16) Or ((y * 255 / 239) Shl 8) Or 128
	Next
Next
UnlockBuffer BackBuffer()
Flip
WaitKey
```

![LockBuffer](media/buffers/lockbuffer.png)
@param buffer  The buffer to lock. Defaults to the current buffer.
@gap Up to 8 buffers can be locked at the same time.
@gap The lock works on a copy: drawing commands and [ReadPixel](ReadPixel) do not see what was written until the buffer is unlocked, and when pixels were written, the whole copy replaces the buffer on unlocking, which discards anything that drawing commands drew meanwhile.
